opening.argument: The video presents OneCoin as “A new, innovative crypto- coin” and ties it to success through an invitation for “Free registration” at a specified signup destination. Its promotional appeal is reinforced by the claim that it “will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market,” alongside a reported Bitcoin increase of more than 1000% and assertions of worldwide expansion. These statements frame participation in a new cryptocurrency as an opportunity associated with success and appreciation. The available evidence does not establish what registration requires or what outcome follows, so those details remain unresolved.
